content.text:
I fixed this in `lib/adapters/http.js:474`. The http adapter now lowercases the `content-encoding` value before matching it, so responses labelled `GZIP`, `Gzip`, `Deflate` and so on are decompressed just like lowercase ones. The `|| ''` stops it crashing when the header was already removed for HEAD or 204 responses.

I haven't run any tests, existing or new, and haven't checked it against a real mixed-case response such as the storage.googleapis.com one from the issue.
